data.result_n: Riders shown in the stage result
data.past_n: Number of past stages to browse
data.upcoming_days: Show upcoming stages up to (days ahead)

data_description.start_n: While a race has no result yet, the pop-up shows who is at the start, ordered by the PCS ranking.
data_description.scan_minutes: How often procyclingstats is queried outside of races.
data_description.live_scan_minutes: During a live stage, so the peloton's position keeps up.
data_description.levels: These levels may take the tile and also appear in the pop-up.
data_description.levels_popup: These levels get a button in the pop-up but stay off the tile. Put ProSeries here to follow races like the Tour of Denmark without changing your dashboard.
data_description.max_other: 0 shows only the race on the tile. Every extra race costs requests at procyclingstats and room in the attributes.
